sv.title: Rapport om Trump tonade ned risker – raderades
sv.summary: När Skatteverket öppnade upp för amerikanska molntjänster bortsåg man från flera varningar, samtidigt som riskerna tonades ned i interna rapporter som senare har raderats. Ekots granskning visar att de bland annat gällde Donald Trumps återinträde till Vita huset.

en.title: Report on Trump downplayed risks – deleted
en.summary: When the Tax Agency opened up for American cloud services, it disregarded several warnings, while the risks were downplayed in internal reports that have since been deleted. Ekot's investigation shows that they concerned, among other things, Donald Trump's return to the White House.
